name: No Fine Print
oneLiner: Tells small teams which competitions they can actually win, and traces every eligibility verdict to the rule it came from.
description: Builders chase hackathons, grants and challenges with no decision support: eligibility rules are scattered across microsites, FAQs and living terms documents. No Fine Print reads the rules, checks every team member against them with a deterministic engine, ranks what is left by expected prize per entry, and drafts application kits that cannot overclaim.

evidence.fact: Eligibility verdicts are computed by code, not by the model, and each links to the clause it came from
175 competitions, grants and programmes in the seed dataset, checked against official pages between 28 Sep and 6 Oct 2026
Every eligibility field Gemini extracts must quote the rules verbatim; fields whose quote is not found are reset to unknown
Guard tests cover two cases that misjudged real projects: repository date instead of first commit, and sponsor employees when the rules are silent
